output_contract.endpoint_catalog: grouped by method + generalized URL pattern + response kind
output_contract.request_templates: query/path/body/header parameter name, location, type, requiredness and evidence ratio
output_contract.response_schemas: JSON/HTML inferred schema and repeated record paths when response body content exists
output_contract.dom_json_correlation: best normalized-name correlation between A-4 DOM fields and response JSON paths
output_contract.session_requirements: header/cookie/auth requirement types only; never raw values

late_binding: Missing response body content does not fabricate fields; downstream late-binding action is emitted.
